A kilojoule (kjoule or kJ) is a unit of measurement for ener-
gy. It is the amount of work required to move 1 kilogram for 
1 meter with the force of 1 newton. A kilocalorie (kcalorie 
or kcal) is the amount of heat required to raise 1000 mL 
(1 liter) of water 1° Celsius; 1 kcal  4.2 kJ. Th e kilojule is
the most commonly used measure of food energy; however,
the kilocalorie is the measure of food energy most com-
monly used in the United States.
